'''Towe''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] residing on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] until [[3643 BBY]], when he was [[Death/Legends|killed]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Towe appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on Tatooine. He is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
